genius.notes: DUSD was publicly offered to EU/UK account holders in Fluid's 2021-22 materials and described as 1:1 redeemable, but current operations and reserve reporting are not verified. No token-specific U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, state qualification, or foreign-issuer registration was located as of 2026-08-14; the foreign-issuer and state-qualified frameworks remain in proposed rulemaking.
